translations.web: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
translations.bsb: Then tell Pharaoh that this is what the LORD says: ‘Israel is My firstborn son,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
